lines.en: Swimming upstream is the only real travel.
The current pushes back. I push forward.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，石头就退后了。
lines.en: One flick of my tail and the stones slide past.
I have swum this river a hundred times.
The water is cold. My gills work faster.
A drop ahead. I jump.
Follow me. The school is ahead.
Sand is easier than stone under me.

lines.zh: 我贴着河床走，影子在上面。
lines.en: I hug the riverbed. My shadow rides above.
Weeds brush my belly. It tickles a little.
At the bend, the whole school turns together.

lines.zh: 海就在下游，我不急着去。
lines.en: The sea is downstream. I am in no hurry.
Fins out, and my speed picks up.
In the shallows, the water barely covers my back.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤过去，鳞片刮了一下。
lines.en: I squeeze through a stone gap and scrape a scale.

lines.zh: 上游的水更凉，我的鳃动得勤。
lines.en: Upstream is colder, so my gills work harder.
Mouth open, let the water pass my gills.
Hovering here, neither moving nor sinking.

lines.zh: 有只螃蟹在石头下看我。
lines.en: A crab watches me from under the stone.

lines.zh: 水里很静，只有泡泡的声音。
lines.en: It is quiet down here. Only bubbles speak.

lines.zh: 等一片叶子漂过去，我再动。
lines.en: I wait for a leaf to drift by before I move.

lines.zh: 大鱼来了，我往下沉一点。
lines.en: A big fish comes. I sink a little.
Sunlight breaks into pieces on the surface.

lines.zh: 我数不清自己绕了几圈。
lines.en: I have lost count of my circles.

lines.zh: 鳃盖一开一合，一天就过去了。
lines.en: Gills open and close. That is a whole day.
This stone is my spot.
The riverbed mud is soft against my side.

lines.zh: 有东西在水面拍打，我不上去。
lines.en: Something slaps the surface. I stay down.
My kin crowd into the shade.

lines.zh: 我吐了个泡，看它浮上去。
lines.en: I blow a bubble and watch it rise.
Your shadow covers my water.

lines.zh: 两条腿站在岸上，真奇怪。
lines.en: Two legs, standing on the bank. Strange.

lines.zh: 你要下来吗？水比看上去深。
lines.en: Coming in? The water is deeper than it looks.
Do not scoop me up. I am slippery.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水里变得好大。
lines.en: Your face looks huge through the water.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，上周来过。
lines.en: I know those boots. You came last week.

lines.zh: 盯再久，我也不会自己上岸。
lines.en: Staring will not make me beach myself.

lines.zh: 你的桶里已经有一条了。
lines.en: There is already one in your bucket.
The glare hides you from me.
Crouched like that, you look like a heron.
Two of my scales scraped off.
There is nowhere to hide in water. You are fast.
I should be running downstream.
That scattered the whole school.
My side fin is trembling.
Do not chase me in water. I know these paths.
The water changed color. I must go.
The sting makes me blunder into stones.
You caught my tail.
My gills close slowly. I cannot breathe well.
Is that a bug? Bring it closer.
Something red wiggles. I follow.
I will not bite the hook. I am only looking.

lines.zh: 水面上的碎屑，先到先得。
lines.en: Crumbs on the surface. First come, first fed.

lines.zh: 你撒下的东西，闻着像面包。
lines.en: What you scattered smells like bread.

lines.zh: 别拿亮片骗我，我吃过亏。
lines.en: Do not fool me with shiny metal. I learned once.

lines.zh: 这条虫游得不对，是假的。
lines.en: That worm swims wrong. It is a fake.

lines.zh: 我围着它转三圈再决定。
lines.en: I circle it three times before deciding.

lines.zh: 饿的时候，什么都值得一试。
lines.en: When hungry, anything is worth a try.

lines.zh: 你手上的味道，混着鱼腥。
lines.en: Your hands smell of fish.

lines.zh: 撞到我？鳞片滑，你抓不住。
lines.en: Bump me? My scales slip through your grip.

lines.zh: 水里也会撞，河道太窄了。
lines.en: We bump even underwater. The channel is narrow.

lines.zh: 整群挤在一起，谁也躲不开。
lines.en: The school packs tight. No one can dodge.
A paddle jab? I swerve.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞偏了半条河。
lines.en: That knocked me half a river off course.
A scale came off. It will grow back.

lines.zh: 别踩水底的卵石，那是我的床。
lines.en: Do not tread the pebbles. That is my bed.

lines.zh: 水花溅起来，你裤脚湿了吧。
lines.en: A splash. Your cuffs are wet now.

lines.zh: 鱼群里撞一下，不算失礼。
lines.en: A nudge in the school is no insult.
After the bump, swim on. Do not look back.

lines.zh: 往上游去，那里有产卵的浅滩。
lines.en: Upstream, where the shallows wait for eggs.

lines.zh: 整条河都在往同一个方向挤。
lines.en: The whole river presses the same way.

lines.zh: 红起来的时候，就是要回去了。
lines.en: When I turn red, it is time to go home.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在石缝边等我。
lines.en: My mate waits by the gravel seam.

lines.zh: 我们刨开沙，把未来埋进去。
lines.en: We dig the sand and bury the future in it.

lines.zh: 产完这一趟，我就没力气了。
lines.en: After this run, I will have nothing left.

lines.zh: 同族成千上万，我只认那一条。
lines.en: Thousands of us, and I know only one.
The shallower the water, the closer we press.

lines.zh: 祖先也在这条河里做过同样的事。
lines.en: My ancestors did this in the same river.

lines.zh: 别打扰，这段水路只剩一次。
lines.en: Do not disturb us. This run happens once.

lines.zh: 沉底的橡果，我用嘴顶了顶。
lines.en: I nosed a sunken acorn along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 沉在水底的东西，看看就好。
lines.en: Things sunk to the bottom are for looking only.

lines.zh: 那块亮片？让水流带走吧。
lines.en: That shiny scrap? Let the current take it.
My mouth holds water, not trinkets.
I once carried weed in my mouth. Does that count?

lines.zh: 桶里的鱼食，我抢不过同伴。
lines.en: In the bucket, my kin beat me to the feed.

lines.zh: 水底的硬币，我顶了一下。
lines.en: I nosed a coin on the riverbed.

lines.zh: 东西掉进河里，就归河了。
lines.en: What falls in the river belongs to the river.
All I turn over is a pebble.

lines.zh: 别把垃圾丢进来，我不吃。
lines.en: Do not drop trash in here. I will not eat it.
Something moves. Smaller than me.
That water strider is right at my mouth.
Chase it? It is a little faster than me.
A bug fell in. I wait.

lines.zh: 我不追大鱼，追了也追不上。
lines.en: I do not chase big fish. I would lose.
The target is tiny. One gulp and it is gone.
A splash, and my head turns.
Today I chase only this one.

lines.zh: 它躲进石缝，我守在外面。
lines.en: It hides in a crevice. I wait outside.

lines.zh: 追到一半，我忘了为什么。
lines.en: Halfway through, I forget why.
A little closer, and I dart.
It goes left. I go left.
The ripples give it away.
I fix on that trembling spot.
It is more panicked than me. That is enough.
Circle clockwise and cut it off.

lines.zh: 别让光影骗了我的眼睛。
lines.en: Do not let the light fool me.
Mouth open, I close in silently.
Right now, only it exists in the water.
One last tail flick. Now.
One bite, and only water.
I butt it, and it flips over.
Small teeth, but they work.
It escaped. I keep a scale in my mouth.
This bite means I am hungry.
I shake my head and throw it clear.

lines.zh: 水里打架，靠的是转身快。
lines.en: Underwater, fights are won by turning fast.
Missed. Here comes another try.
It is smaller than me. Unfair, but so is the river.
Done. My gills are still moving.
Out of the egg, the first lesson is swimming.

lines.zh: 这条河的水，我一生都记得。
lines.en: I will remember this water all my life.

lines.zh: 我刚孵化，只有指甲那么长。
lines.en: Just hatched, no longer than a fingernail.
Sand is still in my gills.

lines.zh: 上游的水声，是我出生的地方。
lines.en: The sound upstream is where I began.

lines.zh: 同伴成千上万，一起涌出来。
lines.en: Thousands of us pour out together.
The sea is vast. I have not seen it.
Do not scoop me up. I am still small.

lines.zh: 第一口吃的是水里的小虫。
lines.en: My first meal was a midge in the water.

lines.zh: 我摆了一下尾，就算开始了。
lines.en: One flick of my tail, and it begins.

lines.zh: 烫！谁把岩浆倒进河里了？
lines.en: Hot! Who poured lava into my river?
Washed over the falls. My head spins.

lines.zh: 没有水，我张嘴也吸不到。
lines.en: No water. My mouth opens and takes nothing.

lines.zh: 炸起的水柱把我掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast threw up a column and flipped me.
An arrow came in. The water slowed it.

lines.zh: 水里泛起紫光，鳞在发麻。
lines.en: Purple light in the water. My scales tingle.
So hungry I would bite the weeds.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，整条河都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the river. The whole channel lit up.

lines.zh: 水没了，下面什么都没有。
lines.en: The water is gone. Nothing below.
